supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: extends moderately beyond the outer corners of the eyes as a 2D bounding width

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast; significantly lighter muzzle region against very dark periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: moderate 2D vertical thickness with a visible structural droop of the lower lip

other_distinctive_markers: distinct high-intensity pixel patch (bright reflection or light skin) centered on the supraorbital ridge
